ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform that converts long-form regional startup pitch videos into searchable, structured data and summaries for investors.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the submission bottleneck by helping startup founders automatically organize and polish their video submissions and pitch artifacts into investor-ready formats.

ideas.title: FoundersCrew Chief
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven productivity-agent patterns from recent hackathon winners to keep student teams disciplined over a multi-day timeline, ensuring they ship a working MVP.
